newsitem.title: USA: Edison Intl Mohave unit in restart mode.
newsitem.headline: Edison Intl Mohave unit in restart mode.

text.p: A 790 megawatt (MW) unit at the Mohave coal-fired plant near Laughlin, Nev., is in restart mode and should reach scheduled capacity of 750 MW late Monday, according to sources familiar with the plant's operations.
The unit tripped off line Wednesday morning due to a boiler tube leak.
Mohave's other 790 MW unit continue to operate at a reduced capacity near 640 MW due to smokestack emission limitations, the sources said.
The Mohave plant is majority-owned and operated by Edison International's Southern California Edison Co.
